modules.title: Carry-on
modules.lede: A large cabin bag can be added online in 'Manage booking' or through the Service Centre up to 4 hours before departure.

personal_item.value: Small hand luggage (40x30x25 cm, 5 kg) is included for all LEAV guests.

carryon_bag_dimensions.value: Large hand luggage: 55x40x20 cm. Included depending on fare; otherwise 18€ online or 32€ at the Service Centre.

carryon_weight.value: Large hand luggage up to 8 kg; small hand luggage up to 5 kg.

modules.title: Checked baggage
modules.lede: Checked bags can be added online in 'Manage booking' or through the Service Centre up to 4 hours before departure.

fees.value: First checked bag (max. 20 kg): 25€ online, 39€ at the Service Centre. Second checked bag (max. 20 kg): 49€ online, 79€ at the Service Centre. Included depending on fare.

size_weight.value: Each bag up to 20 kg as booked; overweight is charged €12 per extra kilo at the airport (€15 on flights to and from Beirut, Damascus and Aleppo). No piece may exceed 32 kg.

phone_home_market.notes: Given on LEAV's luggage page for booking an extra cabin seat for instruments.

modules.title: If your flight is delayed or cancelled
modules.lede: These are standards published by the carrier for delays and cancellations. On codeshares or interline itineraries, the operating carrier is responsible.

care.value: When a flight is delayed or cancelled within carrier control, passengers are entitled to meals, refreshments, communication access, and hotel accommodation with transport for overnight delays.

rebooking_refund.value: For disruptions within carrier control, the airline rebooks passengers on the next available flight or provides a full refund for unused flight segments if delayed by 3 hours or more.

compensation.value: Statutory or policy compensation applies for cancellations or long delays within carrier control according to applicable aviation passenger rights regulations.
